title: catabrosa scabra
intro: Catabrosa scabra, commonly known as Bristle Bent or Rough Catabrosa, is a type of grass. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to help manage diabetes and blood pressure due to its antidiabetic and hypotensive properties. The therapeutic actions of Catabrosa scabra include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antibacterial activities, which may contribute to its potential in wound healing and antimicrobial applications. The bioactive constituents of Catabrosa scabra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
